title: A filter argument on one column keeps the filter on another column of the same table

source.quote: Filters on columns other than those mentioned in the arguments of CALCULATE or other related functions remain in effect and unaltered.
source.supports: only filters on the columns named in the filter argument are replaced; the Category filter is unaltered

source.quote: the predicate shown in the first expression is internally converted in the second expression
source.supports: the predicate becomes a filter over the Color column only

derivation: Vehicles and Red: Bike, rows 1, 5, 7 = 100 + 200 + 100 = 400. Accessories and Red: Helmet, rows 2, 3 = 40 + 20 = 60.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
